lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Pal.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: you've seen Ade

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: fight, right?
Yeah, she's incredible.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: I know, right?!

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Okay, so I wasn't seeing things.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: I thought she was just some mild-mannered maid,

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: and wow, was I shocked.
Why are you bringing up Ade anyway?

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: After seeing her like that,

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: how could I just stay calm?

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: It's been ages since I've felt something surging up inside me.
You want to take her on?

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Yeah, that's right.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: But her agreeing to any sudden challenge of mine

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: doesn't really seem like her style, so I'm not sure what to do.
Want me to ask her for you?

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Oh,

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: you'd really do that?
Sure. I'll even be the referee.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Ohh, that would be great!

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Haha.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Starting today, it's special training time!

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Pack your stuff and meet me at the gym.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: You'll join me, won't you, Pal?
Is it really okay? We haven't even asked Ade yet.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: It doesn't matter if the challenge doesn't happen.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: I just can't stay still with this feeling bubbling inside me.
That's a great mindset.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Kek, you betcha!

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: That's what sports are all about!

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: What do I have to bring...?

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Gloves, bandages, shin guards...

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: That should be enough, right?
Bring the bunny girl outfit too.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Wha... Why the bunny girl outfit?

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: You want me to train in that?
The thinner the outfit, the higher the defense. Everyone knows that.
Ade is at her strongest in a bunny girl outfit.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Pal, what are you even saying?

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: That kind of thing only applies to other universes!

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: That has nothing to do with it at all!

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: As long as the outfit doesn't get in the way,

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: anything should be fine!

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Sigh... Pal,

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Are you sure this isn't just because you want to see me in a bunny girl outfit?
No, that's not it!

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Pal, don't lie.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Put your hand on your chest and tell me again.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Is that really not the reason?
Honestly, it's been a while, so I've been wanting to see you in a bunny girl outfit...

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: I knew it.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Well, I guess it can't be helped.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: If you want it that much,

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: I might just have to think about it.
You're the best, Milk.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Don't get your hopes up.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: I've not decided yet.
Haha, got it.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: Then tell Ade to wear it too.

lines.speaker: milk_b
lines.text: I'll totally die of embarrassment if I'm the only one who wears it.
